mentions.name: SUS
mentions.description: SUS is a custom hardware description language used to build high-bandwidth memory streaming interfaces for HBM on VCK5000 and U280 FPGAs. It aims for consistent 450MHz synthesis so a narrower 256-bit interface can sustain full bandwidth in place of a 512-bit interface; current FMax results range 440-490MHz with some edge cases remaining.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building high-bandwidth memory streaming interfaces for HBM on VCK5000 & U280 FPGAs in my own language - "SUS".
